virtual-threads-concept-038.title: Use virtual threads
virtual-threads-concept-038.short: Run many blocking tasks with lightweight threads
virtual-threads-concept-038.summary: Virtual threads are lightweight Thread instances designed to make thread-per-task code scale to large numbers of concurrent blocking operations.
virtual-threads-concept-038.why: They let straightforward blocking code handle high concurrency without tying each task to a dedicated operating-system thread.
virtual-threads-concept-038.tips: Use virtual threads for numerous blocking tasks; do not expect them to make CPU-bound work execute faster.

pattern-switch-concept-038.title: Use patterns in switch
pattern-switch-concept-038.short: Match values by type in switch
pattern-switch-concept-038.summary: Pattern matching for switch can select a branch by a value's type and bind the matched value.
pattern-switch-concept-038.why: It makes type-based dispatch more concise and keeps matching logic in one expression or statement.
pattern-switch-concept-038.tips: Keep cases exhaustive where practical and order guarded or specific cases clearly.

files-mismatch-code-038.title: Find where two files differ
files-mismatch-code-038.summary: Files.mismatch compares two files and returns the position of the first differing byte, or -1 when their contents match.
files-mismatch-code-038.why: It avoids writing a manual byte-by-byte comparison loop.
files-mismatch-code-038.tips: Handle IOException and remember that metadata differences are not the comparison target.

zone-rules-exception-038.title: Handle unknown time-zone IDs
zone-rules-exception-038.summary: Date-time zone lookup can fail when a requested zone identifier has no available rules.
zone-rules-exception-038.why: Zone identifiers must be known to the installed time-zone rules provider.
zone-rules-exception-038.tips: Prefer region IDs such as Asia/Tokyo when regional daylight-saving rules matter.

unsupported-charset-exception-038.title: Handle unsupported character sets
unsupported-charset-exception-038.summary: UnsupportedCharsetException is thrown when a requested named charset is not supported by the runtime.
unsupported-charset-exception-038.why: Arbitrary external charset names may not identify an installed charset.
unsupported-charset-exception-038.tips: Use StandardCharsets constants for standard encodings and validate user-supplied names.

multicatch-related-types-error-038.title: Use related types in multi-catch
multicatch-related-types-error-038.short: Multi-catch alternatives must not subclass one another
multicatch-related-types-error-038.summary: A multi-catch cannot contain alternatives where one exception type is a subclass of another alternative.
multicatch-related-types-error-038.why: The broader catch alternative already handles instances of its subclass, making the narrower alternative redundant.
multicatch-related-types-error-038.tips: Keep only the common supertype or split catches when behavior must differ.

duplicate-switch-label-error-038.title: Repeat a switch case label
duplicate-switch-label-error-038.short: Each switch label must be distinct
duplicate-switch-label-error-038.summary: The compiler rejects duplicate case labels within the same switch.
duplicate-switch-label-error-038.why: Two identical labels would make branch selection ambiguous and the later branch unreachable for that label.
duplicate-switch-label-error-038.tips: Check generated constants too, because distinct constant names can still have equal values.

varargs-heap-pollution-warning-038.title: Use generic varargs unsafely
varargs-heap-pollution-warning-038.short: Generic varargs can expose heap pollution
varargs-heap-pollution-warning-038.summary: Varargs whose element type is non-reifiable can produce unchecked warnings because the runtime array cannot fully represent the generic component type.
varargs-heap-pollution-warning-038.why: Aliasing the varargs array through Object[] can permit values that violate the apparent generic type.
varargs-heap-pollution-warning-038.tips: Avoid unsafe writes and use @SafeVarargs only when the method body is actually safe.

bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap-038.title: Compare BigDecimal values with equals
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap-038.summary: BigDecimal.equals considers both numeric value and scale, so 1.0 and 1.00 are not equal by equals.
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap-038.why: BigDecimal represents scale as part of its value object identity even when compareTo reports numerical equality.
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap-038.tips: Use compareTo when the requirement is numerical equality regardless of scale.

stream-reuse-trap-038.title: Reuse a consumed stream
stream-reuse-trap-038.summary: After a terminal operation consumes a stream, the same stream cannot be used for another operation.
stream-reuse-trap-038.why: Streams represent one traversal pipeline rather than a reusable collection of elements.
stream-reuse-trap-038.tips: Create a fresh stream from the source for each independent traversal.
